name: voice
title: Voice call with an orb
shows: A call card: a status and timer, the assistant's orb, who is talking, captions that light up word by word, and a bar with mute, a waveform and end call. On a dark surface the orb is a live effect (orb-sphere: a pale nebula with specks of light); on a light one a pearl drawn in CSS, with clouds of the accent and the ink turning slowly inside it and a few specks of light.
place: at-rise to-edge fit, 32px down, cut by the bottom through its bar's lower half at most (the orb, the caption and the waveform stay clear of the fade); needs ../effects next to ui (assets/effects) for the live orb. Held like any other fragment unless it is the group's data-ui-loop (its orb holds one frame)
edit: The caption, names and time are HTML; the script speaks the caption as written (opts.lines: several in turn) and counts on from the time as written. opts.orb: false keeps the CSS pearl on dark.
loop: about 2.75 s a cycle: the wave runs, the caption is spoken again word by word in under 0.8 s (never below 72% ink) (or opts.lines in turn), the timer counts on; the finished picture holds for at most 15% of the cycle; restarts when the pointer enters its card; held (data-ui-still, a phone, kind other) it shows its finished picture and plays while the pointer is on its card
